notes.normal_path: All inference scenarios use AIClient.chat(), CognitionLayer, or AgentCore and therefore AuroraCoreRuntime.chat_local_only(). Inference rows must also name an allowed local runtime for the measured platform; blank/unknown runtimes fail closed.
notes.network: The measured phase must run under an OS outbound-Internet block for Godot and llama-server; localhost remains available for the bundled Core engine.
notes.external_ai: Ollama and remote AI are forbidden. Compatibility is enabled deliberately in one scenario to prove it cannot reroute normal chat.
notes.fixture_policy: Synthetic/fake-core smoke tests are contract tests only and never count as LLM quality evidence.
